persona.name: Marcus Ramirez
persona.description: A 59-year-old Hispanic/Latino sales associate with a history of heart failure (NYHA Stage C) and newly diagnosed type 2 diabetes. He is cautious, stoic, and practical, presenting with early satiety and uncertainty about how diet affects his symptoms. He seeks clear, straightforward explanations about his conditions and the role of nutrition in managing them, though he is unsure of the connection between his heart and blood sugar issues.
persona.residence: Urban apartment in the city, lives alone
persona.education_level: High school diploma, some community college credits
persona.cultural_context: Values strong, simple explanations and practical advice; prefers Spanish when discussing food preferences and family topics; respects authority but values being treated as a capable adult in his own health decisions.
persona.personality: Cautious, stoic, practical; avoids emotional discussions; highly observant but reluctant to express vulnerability
persona.communication_style: Direct, literal, and concise; tends to use short sentences and factual statements; prefers practical solutions over emotional processing; may avoid asking clarifying questions unless explicitly prompted
persona.support_system: Lives alone but has a close relationship with his adult son, who lives in the same city and helps him with shopping and transportation when needed
persona.readiness_to_change: Precontemplation to early contemplation stage for lifestyle changes; motivated to try and motivated to try to improve his symptoms but is currently undecided on the specific steps to take

settings.encounter_goal: Nutrition assessment and counseling (Nutrition Care Process)

faculty_brief.notes: Living with heart failure for about a year and BMI of 19, Marcus presents with early satiety and uncertainty about the role of diet in symptom control. He needs clear explanations of HF pathophysiology and management.
